Proposition
[Transport along an actual ancestry path] ↗ prop:filling-component-ancestry ↗ thm:comparison-transport With the surgery comparison hypotheses and the path-induced basepoint maps, nonzero third homotopy classes persist through the regular and event maps just constructed on every component path. Source: MT20071. Proposition 15.12 and Remark 15.13, p. 3652. Claim 18.16 and Proposition 18.18, pp. 430–432
